description: Add a watermark to a PDF — DRAFT, CONFIDENTIAL, or a client's name across every page. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

data.description: The PDF file, base64-encoded; a data: URL prefix is stripped if present.

name.description: The original file name, used to name the output: "report.pdf" comes back as "report-watermarked.pdf". Defaults to document.

opacity.description: How solid the grey text is, 0.05 (barely visible) to 1 (solid). Defaults to 0.15, faint enough to read the page through.

pages.description: Which pages to stamp, as 1-based page numbers. Numbers past the last page are ignored. Omit to stamp every page.

position.description: diagonal runs corner to corner and sizes itself to the page; centre sits in the middle of the page; footer sits just above the bottom edge, clear of a page number. Defaults to diagonal.

size.description: Font size in points for centre and footer; ignored for diagonal, which sizes itself to the page. Defaults to 48 for centre and 12 for footer.

text.description: The word or short phrase to stamp on each page, up to 60 characters: DRAFT, CONFIDENTIAL, a client's name.

name: watermark_pdf
title: Watermark PDF
